Detect and repair CASRNs that a spreadsheet converted to dates

Source: R/util_cas.R
repair_cas_date_coercion.Rd

Excel and Google Sheets silently turn some CASRNs into dates on CSV import (e.g. 103-02-6 -> 0103-02-06, 10-13-9 -> 10-13-2009). Roughly 4.6% of DSSTox CASRNs are exposed. No real CASRN has a zero-padded part or a multi-digit check digit, so these shapes are input corruption. Values are repaired only when the reconstruction passes the CAS checksum; otherwise they are flagged with an NA repair and the source file must be re-exported with CASRN columns formatted as text.

Usage

repair_cas_date_coercion(x)

Arguments

x

Character vector of CASRN-column values.

Value

Tibble with flagged (logical) and repair (character, NA when not flagged or not recoverable), one row per element of x.

Details

Recognised shapes:

  • year-month-day with a zero-padded day (Google Sheets display, xlsx date cells read by read_excel_robust()): 0103-02-06, 1975-09-02

  • US month-day-year with a 4-digit 200x year (Google Sheets): 10-13-2009

  • slash dates such as 9/2/1975: flagged only, the field order is locale-dependent so no repair is attempted
